flagged.item: Backtest results are COMPUTED from a third-party mirror, not an official source
flagged.reason: Official NBA.com tables are not downloadable (FAQ) so the 2010-11→2023-24 box scores come from a GitHub mirror (commit a5f108b). Only 1 game / 2 players / 1 final score were checked against the official box score. Treat every research number as computed and unverified; raw rows are not committed.

NBA.com FAQ says stats are not available for download for academic or personal use. Whether the mirror's redistribution/use is permitted is not established. Obtain licensed data before any production use.

Sportsbook prices are commercial data, not published by official league sources. 'Own lines' are evaluated against a transparent market PROXY (50/50 season-to-date and recency blend) at an ASSUMED −110 price. Edges versus this proxy are NOT evidence of edges versus real markets, which price minutes, injuries and matchups far better.

flagged.item: Holdout was opened more than once
flagged.reason: Design iteration 1 compared strategies against a naive season-to-date baseline and showed implausibly high hit rates (e.g., ~61% on totals, ~58% on player points just by betting recency form — see Research page control). The baseline was then replaced by the stronger proxy and strategies redefined. Because the 2020-21→2023-24 holdout was viewed before the redesign, it is not a pristine out-of-sample test. Prospective replication (gate G12) is required.
Gate G12 (prospective replication) cannot run: the mirror ends at 2023-24 and no 2024-25/2025-26 official data was obtainable. No strategy is called validated.
Official glossary defines PACE as possessions per 48 minutes but gives no box-score possession formula. Project uses FGA + 0.44·FTA − OREB + TOV.
These only re-weight the recency term already inside the proxy. Their wins show the proxy's 0.5 recency weight is arbitrary, not market inefficiency. They are shown but never ranked.

Each parlay leg is priced at an ASSUMED −110 (decimal 1.9091) with no correlation repricing. Same-player combos show the highest ROI precisely because their legs are positively correlated (ρ≈0.15–0.20); books reprice or restrict such combos, so those ROIs are not achievable. They are blocked by gate G8.
